Focal announcement: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: NVIDIA AI Achieves World Record in Route Optimization.

Decision cutoff: 2023-03-21T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: NVIDIA AI Achieves World Record in Route Optimization. Published date: 2023-03-21. URL: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/2023/03/21/cuopt-world-record-route.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Promising more timely deliveries for consumers around the globe, NVIDIA’s cuOpt real-time route optimization software has set records on a key route optimization benchmark. Nearly 150 billion parcels are shipped every year, according to Pitney Bowes . Introduced in 2021, NVIDIA cuOpt offers enterprises the ability to adapt to real-time data to optimize delivery routes by analyzing billions of feasible moves per second. The result: cuOpt delivered an improvement 7.2x higher than the improvement over the previous record on the benchmark and 26.6x higher than the improvement gained by the record-setting effort before that. cuOpt GTC sessions Advances in Operations Optimization Accelerated AI Logistics and Route Optimization 101
